replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I must admit that I do feel a bit anxious when faced with complex mathematical problems. It's not something I enjoy, but I know it's important to push through and try to understand it as best as I can.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't personally used AI for math learning recently. I'm more of a traditional learner, preferring books or face-to-face explanations. However, I've heard good things about AI tutors and might consider trying one if it's user-friendly.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Oh dear, Principal Component Analysis sounds quite advanced. replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: I think LLMs could make math more accessible by providing personalized explanations and practice problems.
